article_framing_rejections.headline: Buc-ee's Clears St. Lucie County Planning as Indrio Road Growth Builds

lead_independence.headline: Buc-ee's Clears St. Lucie County Planning as Indrio Road Growth Builds
lead_independence.lead: The proposed Buc-ee's travel center at Interstate 95 and Indrio Road in northern St. Lucie County has completed the county's planning process and now awaits final approvals from the Florida Department of Transportation and the Florida Department of Environmental Protection before construction can begin. The 76,000-square-foot travel center would include approximately 120 fuel pumps and could become the largest Buc-ee's location in Florida, with a previously targeted opening date of 2028.
